brief:
The Petroleum Authority in Gaza announced Wednesday that five trucks carrying cooking gas have entered the enclave, Shehab Wire reported. The shipment marks a delivery of fuel supplies to the territory amid ongoing shortages.

No additional details were provided regarding the source of the gas, its destination distribution points, or whether the delivery would address the broader fuel crisis affecting the strip.

title: Five cooking gas trucks enter Gaza Strip
